description: The National Pollutant Inventory holds information on toxic substances emitted to the environment and transferred as contained waste by Australian facilities, published by the Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. Coverage starts on 1 July 1998, and the dataset is updated on or before 31 March each year, with smaller updates at any time; the resources were refreshed on 31 March 2026. On data.gov.au it is published as a set of tables, each in XLSX and CSV: facilities (also GeoJSON and KMZ), reports, emissions, transfers, transfer destinations, emission reduction techniques and further tables, with a data dictionary. Downloads are free under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence. Caveats: the department's own NPI pages could not be opened from this session, so the substance list and reporting thresholds were not read; only facilities that trigger reporting thresholds appear. For simulation it gives geolocated industrial and mining facilities with their emissions and waste transfers for hazard exposure, natech and environmental impact studies. Related catalogue records include Canada's National Pollutant Release Inventory, the U.S. Toxics Release Inventory and the European Industrial Emissions Portal.
